patch.summary:
Choose Help Scout only if your buying job matches “SMB shared inbox and helpdesk — free for up to 5 users; Standard $25, Plus $45, Pro $75 us” rather than Intercom's shape. Choose Intercom only if your buying job matches “Customer messaging / shared inbox with Fin AI — Essential from $29/seat/mo + Fin from $0.9” rather than Help Scout's shape. Workflow advantage: Help Scout leans helpdesk-ticketing, knowledge-base-self-service; Intercom leans live-chat-support, customer-messaging. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: Help Scout is SMB shared inbox and helpdesk — free for up to 5 users; Standard $25, Plus $45, Pro $75 user/mo annual.; Intercom is Customer messaging / shared inbox with Fin AI — Essential from $29/seat/mo + Fin from $0.99/outcome. Primary live-chat; BC + CS secondary..
- Company-size focus: Help Scout (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs Intercom (small-business, mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Help Scout-leaning helpdesk-ticketing, knowledge-base-self-service vs Intercom-leaning live-chat-support, customer-messaging, whatsapp-support.
- Researched limits: Help Scout — Not enterprise omnichannel depth — thinner social/voice than Zendesk Suite; Intercom — Seat + Fin outcome pricing stacks — TCO rises with AI resolution volume.

Limitations — Help Scout: Not enterprise omnichannel depth — thinner social/voice than Zendesk Suite; AI Answers is usage-priced at $0.75/resolution — TCO can climb; Intercom: Seat + Fin outcome pricing stacks — TCO rises with AI resolution volume; SMS, WhatsApp and Phone are pay-as-you-go add-on channels, not unlimited included.

Poor-fit cases: Help Scout is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not enterprise omnichannel depth — thinner social/voice than Zendesk Suite · Intercom is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Seat + Fin outcome pricing stacks — TCO rises with AI resolution volume · Avoid Help Scout if you actually need Intercom's motion (Customer messaging / shared inbox with Fin AI — Essential from $29/seat/mo + Fin)
